title: What If the Sun Became a Black Hole?
lines: What if the Sun suddenly became a black hole?
Here's what would happen. | The strangest part comes last.
For eight minutes and twenty seconds, | nothing would change.
That's how long sunlight takes to reach us.
Even changes in gravity | only travel at the speed of light.
Then, | the sky would go dark.
But Earth wouldn't fly off into space.
It would keep the same orbit, | a hundred fifty million kilometers out.
From that far, | a black hole pulls like any star of the same mass.
So how small is a black hole with the Sun's mass?
About six kilometers wide. | Smaller than a city.
The whole Sun, | in a ball you could drive across in minutes.
Back on Earth, | the cold would set in fast.
Within weeks, | experts estimate the land would drop below minus eighteen degrees.
The oceans would freeze over from the top, | but under the ice, | the deep water could stay liquid for a very long time.
But here's the twist: | the Sun can never do this.
It's far too light. | It would need to be about twenty times heavier.
In about five billion years, | it will begin to swell into a red giant, | then shrink to a white dwarf about the size of Earth.
